title: Workout Archetype
description: A reusable workout shape. Defines the structure of a session — how many slots, of what type, in what format — without specifying which exercises fill them. The selector populates slots with exercises at generation time.

name.description: Human-readable name. e.g. '3×5 Linear Strength', 'Long Zone 2 Run'

modality.description: Primary modality this archetype develops. Use an existing modality ID or define a new one in your package's philosophy scope.

training_levels.description: Training levels for which this archetype is appropriate.

category.description: Broad session category used for scheduling and tagging.

icon.description: The session's workout icon when this archetype leads it: an id from data/commons/workout_icons.json (src/session_icon.py). Without one, the lead exercise's icon, then the category's default.

duration_estimate_minutes.description: Expected session length in minutes, including warm-up and cool-down. Used to match against constraint session_time_minutes.

slots.description: Ordered list of exercise slots within the session. Each slot defines what role an exercise should play and the volume parameters for that role.

role.description: What this slot does in the session. e.g. 'primary_compound', 'accessory', 'conditioning_finisher', 'skill_practice'

slot_type.description: The format that determines how volume is measured.

exercise_filter.description: Constraints on which exercises can fill this slot. Narrows exercise selection.

exercise_ids.description: Only these exercises may fill the slot (still level, equipment and injury filtered). For a slot whose events are fixed by rules, e.g. a pentathlon's five.

ordered.description: Take exercise_ids in order: the first one the athlete can do. The first is the written movement, the rest the substitutes the source declares (a rope climb, or 10 pull-ups without a rope). Without it the listed exercises rotate.

rep_scheme.description: Reps round by round where they change (Fran's [21, 15, 9], Annie's [50, 40, 30, 20, 10]), in place of reps_per_round; one entry a round, so a slot's `rounds` (or its parent's) is its length.

skip_exercise.description: If true, selector skips exercise lookup for this slot.

load.description: The load as the source writes it, shown with the prescription: '75% of today's 1RM', '24 kg (53 lb)', '1.25x bodyweight', 'heavy'. Read by the as_written progression model.

work_sec.description: Work interval length in seconds (interval slots).

pack_load_kg.description: Pack weight for loaded carry / step-up slots.

parent_slot_role.description: Links an amrap_movement component to the AMRAP slot it belongs to.

time_cap_sec.description: Time cap for an amrap/for_time slot. Read by progression._density_slot as the duration fallback.

paced.description: The slot is worked at a target RPM taken from the chosen exercise's competition_pace (max_reps / minutes); the load carries it as target_rpm and the watch paces the set.

switch_at_sec.description: A one-arm block's hand switch, in seconds into the work (a timed block's or each interval's): the load carries it as switch_at_sec, and both watches cue Switch hands and show Left or Right.

rest_until_hr_pct.description: An interval (emom) slot's rest ends once heart rate falls below this share of the athlete's max HR, and rest_sec becomes its cap. The load carries it, with the slot's zone; the server sends it to the watches in bpm (restUntilHr).

standard.description: The standard (data/benchmarks id) this slot measures, and which logged field is the result. A string is the id, the result kind following from the slot type. Packages point at commons standards, never the reverse.

result.description: duration: the time a for-time piece took; rounds: an AMRAP's rounds; reps: max reps (the best set, or reps in a timed set); hold: seconds held; load: a single's kg ÷ bodyweight; distance: metres covered.

scaling.description: How the archetype adapts under common constraint scenarios.

deload.description: Modifications applied during a deload week.

time_limited.description: How to abbreviate if session_time_minutes is shorter than duration_estimate_minutes.

equipment_limited.description: Substitute equipment or approaches if required equipment is unavailable.

required_equipment.description: Equipment needed to run this archetype as written. If any item is missing and no scaling.equipment_limited rule exists, this archetype is unavailable.

applicable_phases.description: Phase kinds (data/commons/phase_kinds.yaml) in which this archetype is appropriate — matched against the kind of the program phase, never its package-local id. If empty, applicable in all phases.

complements.description: The modalities this session best follows on a split day: a day that adds a second (mobility) session after one of these prefers this archetype (scheduler._add_split_sessions, generator). Grappling mobility complements combat_sport; strength mobility the strength modalities.

pool_only.description: A named workout picked only from a framework day category's pool (a phase's week_templates, src/week_template.py), never by modality: it is prescribed as written and means nothing under another progression model.

test.description: This archetype is a test of one or more standards: its slots with `standard` produce the results. A test is placed only by a phase's `tests:` (philosophy.yaml) unless `selectable` is true; its standard slots are prescribed exactly as written (no weekly ramp, level, phase or deload scaling).

selectable.description: Whether ordinary archetype selection may pick it too. Default false: tests are placed, not chosen.
